get.summary: Get users assigned to an area

200.description: List of users assigned to the area

post.description: Crea un nuevo usuario en el sistema
Elimina el token del usuario autenticado

200.description: Returns a list of all olympiads with their associated areas

get.summary: Get a specific olympiad by ID
Get areas of a specific olympiad

200.description: List of areas for the specified olympiad

get.summary: Get all level-grade associations from an olympiad area
get.description: Retrieves all level-grade relationships attached to the specified olympiad area, including their associated level and grade data.

200.description: List of level-grade relationships retrieved successfully

post.summary: Assign a level and its grades to an olympiad area
post.description: Creates a new level, associates it with the given grades, and attaches the resulting level-grade relationships to the specified olympiad area.

delete.summary: Remove level-grade associations from an olympiad area
delete.description: Detaches one or more level-grade relationships from the specified olympiad area without deleting the underlying data.

get.summary: Get all score cuts for an olympiad area
get.description: Retrieves all phases of the specified olympiad area, along with their associated level-grades and score cuts.

200.description: List of score cuts retrieved successfully

post.summary: Assign score cuts to level-grades for a specific phase in an olympiad area
post.description: Creates or updates the score cut (minimum passing score) for each level-grade within a specific phase of an olympiad area.

requestBody.description: Phase ID and list of score cuts per level-grade

data.description: The created or updated OlympiadAreaPhase with its related phase and score cuts

404.description: Olympiad area or level-grade not found

422.description: Validation error (e.g. invalid phase_id or score_cut out of range)
